rv.q: While the script is a little uneven, dwelling too long on some areas, and needing a bit more emphasis on the motivation behind the characters, the story is so compelling, I highly recommend this production.
Unfortunately, the story needlessly splinters in several directions.

cn.t: Critics praise this compelling biographical drama about 1920s medical charlatan Dr. John Brinkley, commending its fascinating true story of radio manipulation and the charismatic portrayal of a quack doctor who captivated Depression-era America.
